newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 352 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 352 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 352 contracts compared with 653 overnight Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
There were six wheat, 191 corn, 83 soybean, 33 soymeal, 30 oat, four corn call and five soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to one cent higher, corn was unchanged to 1/4 cent higher and soybeans were steady to 1-1/4 cents lower.
